_finding: Mostly part-of-speech slips: an Italian adjective entered as a noun and glossed as 'X person'. The app uses pos to decide whether to attach articles and whether to drill a plural, so an adjective tagged noun is not cosmetic.

rows._was: en was 'draper'. Renaming the misspelt droghere in 007 fixed the spelling but left the wrong gloss: a droghiere keeps a drogheria, a grocery shop. A draper sells cloth.
glossed 'predominantly' and tagged adverb, which duplicated prevalentemente directly below it. prevalente is the adjective.
glossed 'tolerant person' as a noun; tollerante is the adjective.
pos was adjective; carisma is a noun. carismatico is the adjective and is already present.
pos was adverb; seduto is a participial adjective.
glossed 'brittle' as a noun. The nut brittle sense exists but the everyday use is the adjective, and nothing else in the file covers crunchy.
en was 'endemic', which is the adjective endemico.
